question_text: The sum of two numbers is 48. The difference is 12. What are the numbers?

hint_ladder.title: Set Up Budget Equations
hint_ladder.text: Hayaan ang Health = H, Education = E. So H + E = 48,000 at H - E = 12,000. Dalawang equation para sa dalawang hindi alam.

hint_ladder.title: Solve for H (Health)
hint_ladder.text: Add the equations: (H+E)+(H-E)=48,000+12,000 → 2H = 60,000 → H = 30,000. Kaya Health budget ay ₱30k.

hint_ladder.title: Find E (Education)
hint_ladder.text: Isubstitute: 30,000 + E = 48,000 → E = 18,000. Kaya Education budget ₱18k.

hint_ladder.title: Confirm with Options
hint_ladder.text: Ang pair (30,000, 18,000) ay Option B. I-check: sum=48,000, diff=12,000. Tama.

A.text: You might have chosen A because 28,000+20,000=48,000 pero ang difference ay 8,000, hindi 12,000.

B.text: Correct. 30,000+18,000=48,000 at difference=12,000, exactly. Nagmula sa tamang formula: larger=(sum+diff)/2, smaller=(sum-diff)/2.

C.text: You might have chosen C because 32,000+16,000=48,000 pero diff=16,000, maling pagkalkula ng average.

D.text: You might have chosen D because 34,000+14,000=48,000 pero diff=20,000; baka na-swap ang values.

next_time_rule: Larger=(Sum+Diff)/2, Smaller=(Sum-Diff)/2. 'Plus-diff hati 2, Kuya; minus-diff hati 2, Bunso.'
deconstruct_text:
Alam mo, parang budget ng barangay ito—may dalawang pondo: Health (mas malaki) at Education (mas maliit). Total ₱48,000, at alam nating mas malaki ang Health ng ₱12,000. Gawin nating equation: H + E = 48,000 at H - E = 12,000.

Step 1: Formula natin: Larger = (Sum + Diff)/2, Smaller = (Sum - Diff)/2. Kaya H = (48,000 + 12,000)/2 = 30,000, at E = (48,000 - 12,000)/2 = 18,000.

Step 2: Verify: 30k+18k=48k, diff=12k. Tamang sagot Option B, ₱30,000 at ₱18,000.

**Bakit mali ang iba?** 28k & 20k: diff=8k. 32k & 16k: diff=16k. 34k & 14k: diff=20k. Laging i-check ang difference!
